output_list.reason: The 'mintTokens' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The 'totalSupply += promoValue;' statement can overflow if 'promoValue' is set to a very large value, causing the 'totalSupply' variable to be stuck at a fixed value.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The '_amount' parameter is not checked for overflow, allowing it to be set to a very large value, causing the 'balances[msg.sender]' variable to be stuck at a fixed value.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The '_amount' parameter is not checked for overflow, allowing it to be set to a very large value, causing the 'balances[_to]' variable to be stuck at a fixed value.

The 'approve' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The 'totalSupply += promoValue;' statement can overflow if 'promoValue' is set to a very large value, causing the 'totalSupply' variable to be stuck at a fixed value.
